remarks: Nestled on a private cul-de-sac in a pristine neighborhood, this like-new renovated 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom residence offers polished luxury and modern convenience just steps from schools and Waveny Park. The parking courtyard leads to a glass enclosed entry with formal living and dining rooms at either end. The white custom kitchen with quartz countertops and new high- end appliances, has a light filled dining area overlooking the property. Walk out to a stunning bluestone patio with a hot tub and pool featuring a waterfall and clear glass fencing surrounded by green lawn-perfect for entertaining or unwinding. Adjacent to the kitchen are a family room with fireplace and large screen tv, and an office with wood paneled modern cabinets. Four fireplaces add warmth and elegance throughout. Retreat to the primary suite with a fireplace, white marble bathroom and an extra-large walk in dressing room. In the lower level enjoy a state-of-the-art 9-seat home movie theater, gym with a dance floor, and a 3-car garage with custom high-lift garage doors and two storage lifts. Cutting-edge technology includes a new touch-screen security system, touch info screens, wall-mounted LCD TVs, and in-ceiling speakers. Additional upgrades include a new driveway with a lighted basketball hoop, a 20KW automatic generator, new 5 zone HVAC systems, a natural gas boiler, and town gas and water. No need to wait for new construction. Time to live your best New Canaan life.
